decisions.reason: The necessary addition of the SK6812 Mini-E LEDs to the standalone 3.3V rail is already represented by the candidate's complete same-message MODIFY.
Its existing normal-operation load coverage already states that the AXP2101 powers all system loads, so identifying the LEDs as 3.3V loads does not require a state change.
The source establishes the SK6812 Mini-E LEDs as 3.3V devices and does not change the 5V boost rail, its control, or its current powered loads.
The LED supply-voltage statement does not change the charge-status display method, GPIO, or dedicated charge-LED interface.
The selected LED voltage does not alter battery overcharge, overdischarge, short-circuit, or DW01A protection requirements.
The source does not affect the battery NTC connector or thermal-protection behavior.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the SK6812 Mini-E selection and 3.3V supply voltage.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the selected SK6812 Mini-E part and its 3.3V supply.
The LED voltage and DCDC1 load assignment do not affect the battery connector family, pin count, pin functions, part number, or unresolved pin order.
The source does not specify a BOM part-number, population, sourcing, or assembly-readiness change.
Confirming the LED supply voltage does not change the number or functional separation of project boards.
The source does not change connector partitioning, connector types, signal routing, or the existing interboard 3.3V power connection.
